scope: Native3-1 spring vertical/contact-state hypothesis only; renderer palette/assembly are separately observed. No runtime integration or camera/horizontal parity claim.

rule.contact: Descending registered feet cross restSurfaceY with observed aligned player. Horizontal contact width is unresolved and is not fabricated here.
rule.contactFraction: Clamp the integer feet coordinate to rest surface while preserving the incoming fractional Y; inferred from independently calibrated ordinary jump history and both observed contact phases.
rule.boost: New A press while compression was already active requests high launch. A held before/on contact and new A after expansion do not request high launch. Exact first/last eligible native-frame boundary remains inferred, not measured.

followingTrajectory.order: For every subsequent active update: v=min(maxFall,v+gravity); y+=v. First launch displacement is distinct from this following-trajectory velocity representative.

sourceQualification.ordinaryJumpInputs: Fresh standard-start applied masks replayed through native3-1 prefix, then actual short jump. Independent normal run-jump model: start -5, held gravity5/32, released gravity9/16, maxfall4. Source images can contain adjacent-update rows; paused samples isolate coherent art.
sourceQualification.calibration: Stable paused low/high first ascent and three later samples each exactly agree after preserving those fractions. Ordinary partial/mixed poses remain separate; one ordinary full pose can be one rendered update ahead of the nominal native response count. Do not claim a raw ordinary-image2px pass by masking this.
unresolved: Exact horizontal contact width and screen-scroll behavior during X lock.
